title: teofurlan.com: home page directions
brief: Personal portfolio home for Teo Furlan: two legs (software with AI agents, hardware), personal-story thread from a kid at a computer to agents and robot arms; recruiter 10-second test.

artboards.title: Drafting sheet
artboards.tradeoff: Most original and tied to his hardware work; the drawing metaphor can feel technical and cool for the AI and story parts

artboards.title: Lab notebook
artboards.tradeoff: Warmest and strongest personal story; slower to scan, the two legs and contact sit lower than in the split layout

artboards.title: Two legs
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest recruiter scan, both legs above the fold; least personal, closest to a conventional dark portfolio
